svg.text: Scaling: give every gene the same footing before PCA
B2M spreads over ~2 units, FOXP3 over ~0.5:
B2M's noise would outweigh FOXP3's signal 4:1
both genes now have mean 0 and SD 1;
FOXP3's on/off pattern counts as much as B2M's
Analogy: measuring people by height in millimetres and weight in tonnes makes every distance a height difference. Converting both to 'standard
deviations from average' lets them contribute equally.
